==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am an intergalactic police officer. I have a laser blaster and a shrinking device. I am also a hobbyist who enjoys constructing miniature buildings for ants to live in.

I face off against an intergalactic tyrant. I manage to defeat them, but they still seem to be unnervingly cocky. They say that no prison in the universe can hold them.

I build a miniature Hawaiian hut as a part of a miniatures contest. I then shrink the alien tyrant down after hitting them with a powerful stun beam. I lock the tyrant away inside of the hut, and I set up small ants as guards to keep the tyrant in line.
